summary: Canelo Alvarez retained his undisputed super middleweight title with a one-sided unanimous decision over Jermell Charlo at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, scoring a seventh-round knockdown and working the body throughout. Charlo, who moved up two weight classes, was passive and spent most of the fight on the ropes. The note also covers round-by-round updates, undercard results, and possible next opponents for Canelo.
one_line: Canelo Alvarez dominated Jermell Charlo by unanimous decision in Las Vegas to retain his undisputed super middleweight title, with a seventh-round knockdown.
key_facts: Canelo Alvarez beat Jermell Charlo by unanimous decision with scores of 119-108, 118-109 and 118-109 at T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas.
Canelo scored the only knockdown of the main event in round seven with a body shot followed by a right hand to the temple.
Canelo's record is now 59-2-2 with 39 KOs, and this was his third defense of the undisputed super middleweight championship.
Canelo unified all four major super middleweight titles when he knocked out Caleb Plant in November 2021.
Canelo, 33, has won three fights in a row since losing to Dmitry Bivol in his light heavyweight title attempt.
Jermell Charlo moved up two weight classes from super welterweight and still owns the IBF, WBA and WBC titles at 154 pounds.
Possible next opponents for Canelo include Terence Crawford, David Benavidez and Jermall Charlo; Crawford would need to move up 21 pounds and may rematch Errol Spence.
Mario Barrios won the interim WBC welterweight title over Yordenis Ugas by scores of 117-108, 118-107 and 118-107, knocking Ugas down in round two and again late.
Ugas lost a point for spitting out his mouthpiece twice; his right eye, the orbital bone broken by Errol Spence Jr. last year, was visibly damaged.
Erickson Lubin won a controversial decision over Jesus Ramos by scores of 115-113, 116-112 and 117-111, though Ramos appeared to be in control.
Elijah Garcia (15-0, 12 KOs), 20, stopped Armando Resendiz in round eight at 1:26 when referee Tony Weeks stepped in, earning his 16th win.
Early preliminary results included knockouts by Frank Sanchez and Oleksandr Gvozdyk and a majority decision win for Terrell Gausha.
